title: Pocket Eclipse Menagerie
summary: A palm-sized one-piece sleeping fox beneath a crescent that reveals an owl shadow, then a leaping rabbit after one quarter-turn.
interaction: Hold Z vertical, aim an ordinary phone flashlight squarely through one broad face, then rotate the entire object 90 degrees about Z for the second story.

light_setup.alignment_cue: Keep the flat feet on a level surface and one broad silhouette face parallel to the wall.

evidence_limit: Shadow outlines are derived digitally from exact CAD geometry; no physical print, phone-light cast, brightness, edge softness, or human recognition has been observed.
